title: UE Asset Migration
description: Inspect asset relationships, approve an exact change plan, execute it once, and verify or roll back the result.

recipes.title: Plan, execute, and verify an asset change batch
recipes.description: Audit asset sources and references, approve a normalized batch, execute once, and verify graph and receipt evidence.

inputs.name: actions
inputs.description: One to one hundred explicit import, reimport, copy, move, rename, delete, or fixRedirectors actions.

steps.purpose: Resolve source assets and inspect their dependency and referencer graph before planning.
Plan the complete batch, review its digest and preconditions, then execute the unchanged request with explicit confirmation.
Read changed assets and relationships again, and compare them with the execution receipt diff.
Roll back with a new request ID and explicit confirmation only when the same Editor still owns a rollbackable receipt, then repeat asset and graph readback.

result.summary: Audited asset change with exact approval, receipt diff, dependency readback, and explicit rollback state.
evidence: dependency and referencer graph before execution
normalized request, preconditions, and plan digest
receipt ID, changed paths, and structural diff
dependency and asset readback after execution
rollback availability and rollback receipt when used
success: all sources and destinations were explicit
referencers were checked before destructive actions
the exact approved plan digest was executed
persistence matched the user's explicit choice
changed assets and relationships were read back
rollback, when requested, used explicit confirmation and was followed by the same graph readback
non-rollbackable actions were identified before execution

resources.description: Action-specific fields, rollback boundaries, plan approval, and readback rules.
